title: Implement caliptra_hwmodel.c: caliptra_if.h on hw-model C binding
description: Create wolfcrypt/src/port/caliptra/sim/caliptra_hwmodel.c. This file implements the three caliptra_if.h functions (caliptra_write_u32, caliptra_read_u32, caliptra_wait) using the hw-model C binding API (caliptra_model_apb_write_u32, caliptra_model_apb_read_u32, caliptra_model_step). Also handles one-time initialization: load ROM from ~/caliptra/rom/ci_frozen_rom/2.1/caliptra-rom-2.1.0-a72a76f.bin, load firmware from ~/caliptra/hw-model/c-binding/out/image_bundle.bin, program fuses, and step the model to ready state. Reference: ~/caliptra/hw-model/c-binding/examples/hwmodel/interface.c for the pattern. Header: ~/caliptra/hw-model/c-binding/out/caliptra_model.h
